dict.string: StillHere uses motion sensors to look for possible fall signals on your watch. These are best-effort sensor readings, not medical-grade detection.
StillHere uses watchOS fall sensing to look for possible fall events. If a possible fall is detected, we will attempt to notify the contacts in your Safety Circle. This is not a medical device.

StillHere can read heart-rate samples from HealthKit if you turn on Heart rate in the StillHere app. If you also turn on heart-rate alerts, readings above 120 BPM or below 40 BPM may be saved to your StillHere account and shared with your Safety Circle. StillHere is not a medical device, does not diagnose, and does not detect health emergencies.
